shortDescription: Configures a SQL database object-level permission in a Microsoft SQL Server instance.

options.name: database
options.description: The name of the database in which the object exists for which to configure permissions.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The hostname of the SQL Server instance to configure.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the SQL Server instance.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port on which the SQL Server instance is listening.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the SQL Server instance.

options.name: object
options.description: The name of the object for which to configure permissions.

options.name: permissions
options.description: The type of database object-level permission to configure.

options.name: principal
options.description: The name of the database user or role for which to configure permissions.

options.name: schema
options.description: The name of the schema in which the object exists for which to configure permissions.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the database object-level permission.
